name: Fairmont Waterfront
insider_take: Vancouver's only luxury waterfront hotel where you can literally cast a fishing line from your balcony into Coal Harbour.
whats_special: The Fairmont Waterfront features a remarkable third-floor herb garden that supplies fresh ingredients to their award-winning restaurants, while the hotel's unique harbor-front location means seaplanes land just steps away. The property sits on reclaimed land that was once part of the original Coal Harbour, and guests frequently spot harbor seals, sea lions, and even occasional orcas from their windows.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view room on floors 10-23 for the best whale watching opportunities during summer months, and visit the rooftop beehives where the hotel produces its own honey.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature HeliPad Bar experience (seasonal), where cocktails are served on the rooftop helipad with 360-degree views of the North Shore Mountains, downtown skyline, and Pacific Ocean. Also explore the nearby Olympic Cauldron from the 2010 Winter Olympics, just a 3-minute walk along the scenic Seawall.
pros: Prime waterfront location with stunning harbor and mountain views
Walking distance to Canada Place, Convention Center, and Gastown
Luxurious amenities including full-service spa and fitness center
Exceptional service standards typical of Fairmont brand
cons: Busy downtown location with urban noise levels
